articles.title: Dallas’ Colossal Biosciences Unveils AI Platform to Help Revive the Dodo Bird
articles.summary: Dallas-based de-extinction company Colossal Biosciences unveiled a new AI platform, GenoMorph, on Wednesday to identify gene-editing targets for reviving the extinct dodo bird. Despite limited dodo genomic data, GenoMorph has identified an estimated 2,300 candidate genetic elements that may determine beak size and shape, the company said.…

articles.title: Dallas Cybersecurity Company Elisity Agrees to $1.3B Acquisition by Quantum Computing Company IonQ
articles.summary: College Park, Maryland-based quantum computing company IonQ agreed to buy Dallas-based cybersecurity company Elisity in an all-stock deal valued at up to $1.3 billion. Publicly traded IonQ said the acquisition of privately held Elisity would create a broader cybersecurity platform for detecting and combating AI and quantum threats. …

articles.title: DFW Airport Creates New Role to Lead AI Push
articles.summary: Dallas Fort Worth International Airport is looking for a tech wizard to pilot its AI program — a significant hire in the airport’s quest to further embrace AI. A job posting on DFW Airport’s website said the full-time principal AI lead, a newly created job, will be the airport-wide “strategic and technical authority” on this quickly evolving technology. …

articles.title: No Wheel, No Pedals, No Mirrors: Tesla’s Autonomous Cybercab Revs Up for Dallas Debut
articles.summary: Tesla’s autonomous ride-hailing Cybercabs — which aren’t equipped with a steering wheel, accelerator pedal, brake pedal or rearview mirrors — will soon hit the streets of Dallas. In an Oct. 10 post on the X social media platform, Tesla’s vice president of AI software, Ashok Elluswamy, said Cybercabs are coming soon to Dallas. …

articles.title: Patented: Citi’s AI-Generated Suspicious Activity Reports and 105 More Inventions Across North Texas
articles.summary: A largely Irving-based team has patented a system that uses AI to help New York-based banking giant Citibank fight financial crime. The company, which has a large corporate office in Las Colinas, received a utility patent for systems and methods to draft suspicious activity reports using large language models.…

articles.title: Despite tough talk from Abbott and Paxton, Texas penalties for data center violations are light
articles.summary: Texas officials are promising tougher enforcement on data centers, but the existing law may offer limited leverage over the industry that has largely failed to report its water use.
